moss_raider.description: Original moss goblin raider, shorter and stockier than the Wayfarer.

layering.neutral: Separate sword/shield overlay sheets attach to a CharacterRig and share its transform.
layering.combat: The action atlases are co-rendered with their held weapon for pose continuity. Hide static overlays during attack/defend actions to prevent doubled equipment.
layering.logical_position: Equipment is visual-only and inherits the rig position; it never edits the logical grid cell.
